# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: 当前门店有效的促销规则列表 (Type: array)
  - **data[].promotionId**: 促销规则ID (Type: string)
  - **data[].promotionType**: 促销类型，31-满额减，33-订单折扣 (Type: string)
  - **data[].ruleCategory**: 规则类别，30-满折/折扣，40-满减 (Type: integer)
  - **data[].beTypes**: 适用业务类型列表 (Type: array of string)
  - **data[].startTime**: 生效开始时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (Type: string)
  - **data[].endTime**: 生效结束时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (Type: string)
  - **data[].gmServiceCode**: 助餐服务编码 (Type: string)
  - **data[].products**: 适用餐品列表 (Type: array)
    - **data[].products[].type**: 餐品范围类型，1-包含，2-不包含，3-全部 (Type: string)
    - **data[].products[].productCode**: 餐品编码 (Type: string)
  - **data[].ruleDetail**: 规则明细 (Type: object)
    - **data[].ruleDetail.orderDiscount**: 订单折扣（满折） (Type: object)
      - **data[].ruleDetail.orderDiscount.discount**: 折扣值（如 30 表示 7 折） (Type: string)
      - **data[].ruleDetail.orderDiscount.startDiscountPoint**: 满额折扣触发门槛（元） (Type: string)
    - **data[].ruleDetail.orderReduce**: 订单满减 (Type: object)
      - **data[].ruleDetail.orderReduce.reduceInfo**: 满减阶梯列表 (Type: array)
        - **data[].ruleDetail.orderReduce.reduceInfo[].startDiscountPoint**: 满额减触发门槛（元） (Type: string)
        - **data[].ruleDetail.orderReduce.reduceInfo[].reduceAmount**: 减免金额（元） (Type: string)
- **message**: No comments found. (Type: string)
- **traceId**: No comments found. (Type: string)
